failure_type: wind / gusts + pop-up / late-appearing obstacles + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The UAV collided with a late-appearing obstacle at 4.3 seconds due to a combination of high cruise speed and a 4.1 m/s tailwind. The obstacle was detected only 0.9 seconds before the collision, and counterfactual analysis confirms that reducing speed, removing wind, or increasing sensing range would have prevented the failure.
